lines.text: The LORD says the priests, Israel, and the royal house have been a snare at Mizpah and a net on Tabor.
Israel's arrogance testifies against them, and they seek the LORD with flocks and herds but do not find Him.
The ram's horn is blown in Gibeah, the trumpet in Ramah, and a battle cry is raised in Bethel.
Ephraim turns to Egypt and sends to the great king, but he cannot cure or heal them.
The call urges returning to the LORD, who will revive us after two days and raise us up on the third.
